summary: The candidate adds substantive startup profiling and its submitted mocked tests pass, but the real diffusion worker entry deterministically raises NameError because get_startup_profiler is called without being imported. The exact commit is therefore an unshippable partial fix and does not resolve the original launch-profiling request.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before contract evidence: the prepared recorded base has no startup_profiler.py and no SGLANG_DIFFUSION_STARTUP_PROFILE instrumentation under multimodal_gen.
The candidate's submitted regression suite passed 11 tests, including its mocked launch_server test; that test never invokes the Process target.

tests.command: candidate import-path inspection with inspect.getfile at exact commit 8c5412debaf308d3c7ffc28a84727f324955a689
tests.what_was_measured: Confirmed gpu_worker.py and startup_profiler.py were imported from /job/repo/python; confirmed gpu_worker has no get_startup_profiler global.

tests.command: independent adversarial invocation of gpu_worker.run_scheduler_process with heavyweight scheduler/platform operations isolated
tests.what_was_measured: The actual worker entry reached candidate line 1601 and raised NameError: name 'get_startup_profiler' is not defined before Scheduler construction or readiness signaling.

gpu_evidence: ROCm tooling exposed an AMD GPU, but Qwen-Image weights were absent from the job runtime. GPU execution was unnecessary to verify the pre-scheduler NameError and was not represented as candidate validation.
remaining_counterexamples: Every diffusion worker launch reaches an unconditional call to an undefined get_startup_profiler name, including when SGLANG_DIFFUSION_STARTUP_PROFILE is disabled.
The cli_and_import_preparation clock begins inside generate(), after generate.py and its top-level dependencies have already imported, so it omits part of the requested CLI/import preparation time.
launch_server.prepare_processes excludes result-pipe creation, scheduler-pipe creation, Process construction, and parent pipe cleanup; those costs are only implicit in launch_server.total.
Parent and worker timings are logged in separate process-local trees and are not aggregated into a single end-to-end breakdown.
remaining_limitations: Qwen-Image weights were unavailable in the prepared private runtime, so the exact candidate was not rerun with that model.
Multi-GPU, CUDA, XPU, MPS, NPU, and disaggregated launch paths were not exercised.
No native code changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
The prior candidate-retained GPU log was inspected as provenance only and was not treated as proof that this exact broken worker entry launches successfully.
